title: UI: Timeline and Stage global keydown handlers double-fire (Delete deletes both frame and stage object)
description: Timeline registers a window keydown handler active whenever its panel is focused (packages/authoring-ui/src/Timeline.tsx:883-955; panel is tabIndex 0 and self-focuses on mousedown 1218-1227). StageArea registers separate window keydown handlers for Enter/playback (StageArea.tsx:3684-3698), Delete (3717-3733), and clipboard Ctrl+C/X/V/D (3736-3765) that only bail on Ruffle focus + INPUT/TEXTAREA/contentEditable, never on timeline focus. Neither side calls stopImmediatePropagation, so both fire for one key: Enter toggles play twice (net no-op), Delete/Backspace removes a frame AND deletes the selected stage object (data loss), Ctrl+C/X/V copies/cuts frames AND the shape clipboard simultaneously. Fix: gate StageArea global handlers on !timelinePanelHasFocus or route all shortcuts through one dispatcher (dispatch/keyboard.ts), or have the Timeline handler stopImmediatePropagation when it consumes a key. Confidence: confirmed interaction wiring; runtime double-effect mechanically certain.
